answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint multiple identities, a Sybil swarm faces exponential capital exhaustion: every replica compounds staking fees like a saffron dye spreading through an isolated lagoon, or lines expanding in an infinite sonnet. Generating n spoofed nodes demands superlinear collateral scaling at 2^n cost.
